visualCharacteristics: Fixed side-by-side layout (one image, one text column) that never wraps into a list.
contentPattern: Two columns: rounded image with yellow accent border beside heading/text/CTA.
usage: One row with two cells: an image and a text column (heading, paragraph, standalone CTA link). Put the text cell first to place the image on the right on desktop.
reuseGuidance: Use for a single image + text feature. For more than two columns or generic layouts use columns.
